g.text: Winsen Manual V1.3: bridge + marked detector lead, pp. 1 and 3.

g.desc: Winsen Manual V1.3: bridge + marked detector lead, pp. 1 and 3.

g.text: Winsen MD62 repurposed for He - constant 3.0 V excitation - calibration-dependent review draft

g.desc: Winsen MD62 repurposed for He - constant 3.0 V excitation - calibration-dependent review draft

g.text: AIN2 = excitation / 2; AIN3 = O2 mid-supply bias.

g.desc: AIN2 = excitation / 2; AIN3 = O2 mid-supply bias.

g.text: Validate zero/span with known O2/He mixes and

g.desc: Validate zero/span with known O2/He mixes and

g.text: controlled temperature, humidity, pressure and flow.

g.desc: controlled temperature, humidity, pressure and flow.

g.text: Reference branch: 2k + 500R trim + 2k across the same 3 V.

g.desc: Reference branch: 2k + 500R trim + 2k across the same 3 V.

g.text: Adjust near air balance; record signed offset and span during calibration.

g.desc: Adjust near air balance; record signed offset and span during calibration.

g.text: HE_EXC_DIV = board excitation / 2; it does not sense remote cable drop.

g.desc: HE_EXC_DIV = board excitation / 2; it does not sense remote cable drop.

g.text: MD62 is a thermal-conductivity sensor, not selective to He. Conditioning and gas-specific calibration are mandatory; no factory He accuracy is specified.

g.desc: MD62 is a thermal-conductivity sensor, not selective to He. Conditioning and gas-specific calibration are mandatory; no factory He accuracy is specified.

g.text: MD62 has no assumed numeric lead order.

g.desc: MD62 has no assumed numeric lead order.

g.text: 3.0 V +/-0.1 V at the sensor; operating current <=120 mA.

g.desc: 3.0 V +/-0.1 V at the sensor; operating current <=120 mA.

g.text: Enable after HOST_3V3 is valid; disable before the ADC loses power.

g.desc: Enable after HOST_3V3 is valid; disable before the ADC loses power.

g.text: LDO may dissipate 0.24 W. Verify temperature and cable voltage drop.

g.desc: LDO may dissipate 0.24 W. Verify temperature and cable voltage drop.
